tenths_only.name: Tenths as Fractions (option)
tenths_only.teaches: a whole cut into 10 equal parts: write the tenths shaded, count in tenths, and go past one whole (13/10)
tenths_only.representation: a 10-part strip (black outline, the single grey for shaded parts) in the boxed cell, one fraction slot (stacked numerator/denominator boxes); optional 0-2 line marked in tenths
tenths_only.why: the "fifths, tenths, hundredths" family mixes fifths and hundredths with tenths

dec_fraction_basics.option: set "tenths", "hundredths", "halves and quarters" (and the mirror on d_to_f)
dec_fraction_basics.name: Tenths, Hundredths, Halves and Quarters as Decimals (option)
dec_fraction_basics.teaches: writing tenths and hundredths as decimals and back, and 1/2, 1/4, 3/4 as 0.5, 0.25, 0.75, each with its model
dec_fraction_basics.representation: equation cell 3/10 = □ with a tenths strip or hundred square beside it (hint scaffold, fades); one decimal box with a fixed decimal point
dec_fraction_basics.why: f_to_d/d_to_f mix fifths and denominators; WRM teaches tenths, hundredths and halves/quarters as separate steps

decimal_pv.name: Tenths and Hundredths in a Place-Value Chart
decimal_pv.teaches: tenths and hundredths as decimals in a place-value chart, with counters and base-10 (flat = 1)
decimal_pv.representation: a place-value chart with counters; write the decimal; option: partition 0.36 = 0.3 + 0.06

vis_pv_decimal_places.name: Decimal Places in the Place-Value Chart
vis_pv_decimal_places.build: pv.js gains the places below the ones (Tth, Hth, Thth), the decimal point on the column line, counters 0.1 / 0.01 / 0.001 (also fraction-labelled 1/10 …), decimal digit-chart heads, and decimal bands on place_value_disks, pv_disks_build, value, expand and compare — the dependency of every decimal place-value entry in the fractions lane

vis_hundred_square.name: Hundred Square as One Whole (and the thousand square)
vis_hundred_square.build: a new hundred-square template: a 10 × 10 square as one whole (columns = tenths, cells = hundredths), shade or read, `labels: 'decimal' | 'fraction' | 'percent'`, two squares for more than 1, `grid: 1000`, and the two-tone complement mode the operations entry bonds_100 uses

decimal_whole.name: Make a Whole with Decimals
decimal_whole.teaches: complements to 1 with tenths and hundredths (0.3 + 0.7, 0.45 + 0.55)
decimal_whole.representation: a tenths strip or hundred square with part shaded; write the missing part

dec_compare_2dp.name: Compare Decimals to Hundredths (option)
dec_compare_2dp.teaches: comparing decimals with one or two decimal places, including different lengths (0.4 vs 0.38)
dec_compare_2dp.representation: compare cell: two decimals with a boxed sign slot; optional hundred squares beside each (dec_compare_model)
dec_compare_2dp.why: compare_decimal deals thousandths; Grade 3/Y4 stops at hundredths

dec_compare_model.option: support "hundred squares" beside each decimal and items "same whole?"
dec_compare_model.name: Compare Decimals With Models (option)
dec_compare_model.teaches: comparing decimals to hundredths by reasoning about size, with a hundred-square model, and only when they refer to the same whole
dec_compare_model.ladder: O2 tenths → hundredths → mixed · O3 squares shaded → outline → none · O6 squares / strips

dec_order_2dp.name: Order Decimals to Hundredths (option)
dec_order_2dp.teaches: ordering three to five decimals with up to two places
dec_order_2dp.representation: order cell: numbers in boxed cards, answer slots in a row; optional 0-1 or 0-10 line

round_whole.name: Round Decimals to the Nearest Whole (option)
round_whole.teaches: rounding a 1-dp or 2-dp decimal to the nearest whole number on a number line
round_whole.representation: a "nearest whole" target option with a number-line support

vis_round_line_decimals.name: Rounding Lines for Decimals
vis_round_line_decimals.build: round-line / round-chart / round-pv take decimals (to 1 and 2 dp) and `hops: 'bounds'` (hops to each bound, bounds circled) and `task: 'ends'`

money_convert.name: Dollars and Cents (option)
money_convert.teaches: converting between cents and dollars-and-cents (345 cents = $3.45) and recording money
money_convert.representation: option: cents to dollars and back

money_compare_written.name: Compare Amounts Written in $ and ¢ (option)
money_compare_written.teaches: comparing and ordering amounts written as $2.35, 189¢, $1 and 9¢, converting to one unit first
money_compare_written.representation: compare cell: two price tags (black outline) with a boxed sign slot; order form: three tags and three answer boxes

money_estimate.name: Estimate with Money
money_estimate.teaches: rounding prices to the nearest dollar to estimate totals and change
money_estimate.representation: a price list; write the rounded prices and the estimate

money_2step.name: Two-Step Money Problems
money_2step.teaches: two-step money word problems (buy two items, then find the change)
money_2step.representation: a price list drawn as tags plus a short story; bar model support level

time_calendar.name: Years, Months, Days, Hours
time_calendar.teaches: converting and comparing units of time: years, months, weeks, days, hours, minutes, seconds; days in each month; leap years
time_calendar.representation: a calendar page or conversion table; fill the missing values

day_order.name: First, Next, Then
day_order.teaches: sequencing events and times of day (morning, afternoon, evening, night; before, after; first, next, then)
day_order.representation: three or four picture cards; number them 1-4 in order; option: before/after questions

time_convert.name: Convert Units of Time (option)
time_convert.teaches: converting between seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, months and years

time_units.name: Hours, Minutes or Seconds?
time_units.teaches: a sense of time units: which activities take seconds, minutes or hours
time_units.representation: activity pictures with a unit word bank; option: longer/shorter

time_24h_convert.name: The 24-Hour Clock
time_24h_convert.teaches: converting between 12-hour and 24-hour times and between analogue and digital
time_24h_convert.representation: an analogue clock beside a 24-hour display; write the time; option: a.m./p.m. to 24-hour

turns_angles.name: Turns and Angles
turns_angles.teaches: an angle as an amount of turn; right angles as quarter turns; comparing angles with a right angle (greater/less)
turns_angles.representation: an angle tester (a square corner) beside each angle; tick greater, less or right angle

turns.name: Whole, Half and Quarter Turns
turns.teaches: describing turns (whole, half, quarter, three-quarter; clockwise, anticlockwise) of an arrow or object
turns.representation: an arrow or object drawn before and after a turn; circle the turn from a word bank

shape_draw.name: Draw 2-D Shapes
shape_draw.teaches: drawing 2-D shapes on a dot grid from a name or a description (4 sides, 2 long and 2 short)
shape_draw.representation: a square dot grid; draw the shape; the key shows one correct drawing

symmetry_complete.name: Complete the Symmetric Shape
symmetry_complete.teaches: using a vertical line of symmetry to complete a shape or pattern on a square grid
symmetry_complete.representation: half a shape on squared paper beside a dashed mirror line; draw the other half

two_way.name: Two-Way Tables
two_way.representation: a two-way table with blanks and totals; fill them in

line_graph.name: Line Graphs
line_graph.teaches: reading and drawing line graphs that show change over time
line_graph.representation: a line graph on a grid with labelled axes; read values, find differences, or plot the points

position_map.name: Where Is It? Positions and Maps
position_map.teaches: position and direction language (on, under, next to, behind, in front, left, right, forwards, backwards), following and giving simple directions on a grid map
position_map.representation: a simple picture map on a square grid; answer where-is questions or follow arrows

coord_polygon_draw.option: task "plot and join" and "find the missing vertex"
coord_polygon_draw.name: Draw Shapes on a Coordinate Grid (option)
coord_polygon_draw.teaches: plotting given vertices and joining them to draw a 2-D shape, and finding the missing vertex of a square or rectangle
coord_polygon_draw.representation: first-quadrant grid in the boxed cell (black lines, axes labelled 0-10), plotted points as filled dots; answer "( __ , __ )" boxes
coord_polygon_draw.why: coord_polygon gives the vertices and asks lengths; the WRM step is drawing the shape

translate_grid.name: Translate on a Grid
translate_grid.teaches: translating a shape or point on a first-quadrant grid and describing a translation (3 right, 2 up)
translate_grid.representation: a coordinate grid with a shape and its image; write the translation or draw the image

movement.name: Describe Movement
movement.teaches: describing movement on a grid (up, down, left, right, number of squares) and combining movement with quarter/half turns
movement.representation: a square grid with a start and an object; write the moves; option: follow a route
